notes: IMDuel's chess engine on Ethereum (chain 1), deployed alone before the hook launch: no token, pool, distributor, owner, admin or upgrade path; nothing is called after deployment. ChessEngineV5 is pure: play() chooses a move for a position at a strength (0-10,000 basis points) and applies it by the rules (Rules library, Bitboard library), playAny() picks a seeded legal move. It holds no state and no funds. It compiles at 200 optimizer runs (foundry.toml compilation_restrictions) to stay under the 24,576-byte runtime limit (22,182 bytes).
